# COBOL MOVE Rules Matrix & Specification (#4712)

Part of the **cobolrt-as-a-product** epic ([#4710](https://github.com/squid-protocol/gitgalaxy/issues/4710)).
Single source of truth: [`gitgalaxy/standards/cobol/move.py`](../../gitgalaxy/standards/cobol/move.py).
Generated by `python -m gitgalaxy.standards.cobol regen`.

## 1. Rule Catalogue (MOVE Family)

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALL-LITERAL`

- **Title:** MOVE ALL literal: the literal repeated to the receiver's size
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Figurative constants: ALL literal
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Repeats pattern to fill receiver; numeric receivers align pattern at the right edge.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALPHANUMERIC-TO-NUMERIC`

- **Title:** An alphanumeric sender MOVEd to a numeric receiver read as libcob does
- **Status:** `ASSUMED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: MOVE statement: elementary moves
- **Options:** `DECIMAL-POINT-COMMA`
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Leading spaces and sign skipped; digits aligned on first decimal point; stray chars yield 0.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-DEEDIT`

- **Title:** A numeric-edited sender MOVEd to a numeric receiver is de-edited
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: MOVE statement: de-editing
- **Options:** `DECIMAL-POINT-COMMA`
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Extracts digits, sets negative sign when '-', 'CR' or 'DB' symbol is present.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY`

- **Title:** MOVE by receiver category: alphanumeric padded/truncated, numeric aligned on decimal point, etc.
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: MOVE statement: elementary moves
- **Options:** `DECIMAL-POINT-COMMA`
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Core elementary move: aligns on decimal point, pads/truncates according to picture clauses.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-FIGURATIVE`

- **Title:** MOVE of a figurative constant: ZERO stored as numeric 0, others byte repeated
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Figurative constants
- **Options:** `QUOTE`
- **Register:** `C6`
- **Description:** ZERO/ZEROS stored as value 0 in numeric fields; SPACE/LOW/HIGH/QUOTE filled as byte sequences.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-FLOAT`

- **Title:** A MOVE with a COMP-1 / COMP-2 sender or receiver
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-pg: Conversions and precision
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C6`
- **Description:** Converts between fixed and float precision (9 digits for single, 18 for double HFP).

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-NONDIGIT`

- **Title:** A zoned sender holding a non-digit MOVEd to a zoned, packed or numeric-edited receiver
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** IBM documents no result; oracle uses Zoned byte conversion rules
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** Non-digit byte conversion rules for zoned/packed/edited destinations.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-NONDIGIT-SIGN-REFUSED`

- **Title:** A signed zoned sender whose sign byte is neither digit, overpunch, sign nor space: refused
- **Status:** `REFUSED`
- **IBM Reference:** Undefined data; IBM documents no result
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** Refuses MOVE of dirty sign byte by name when converting to binary or alphanumeric.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-NONDIGIT-TO-BINARY`

- **Title:** A zoned sender holding a non-digit MOVEd to a binary item
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** IBM documents no result; oracle/libcob counts each byte as char - '0' mod 2^64
- **Options:** `TRUNC`
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** Zoned non-digit bytes evaluated as char - '0' in 64-bit unsigned accumulator with TRUNC.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-NUMERIC-TO-ALPHANUMERIC`

- **Title:** A numeric sender MOVEd to an alphanumeric receiver as its unsigned digits
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: MOVE statement: elementary moves
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Overpunched sign removed, separate sign dropped, right-P scaling emitted as zeros.

### `RT-CBL-MOVE-SAME-ZONED-SHAPE`

- **Title:** A MOVE between zoned items of one shape (digits, scale, sign, sign position, size) copies the bytes
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** cobc compiles as memcpy (cb_build_move_copy); sign rewrite and store_common_region never run
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** A space or non-digit in a digit position travels as-is when sender and receiver shapes match.

## 3. Deterministic Test Vectors

| Vector ID | Title | Rule Verified | Note |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `MV01-alnum-pad` | Alphanumeric left-justified, space padded | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY` | Space padding on right |
| `MV02-alnum-trunc` | Alphanumeric truncated on right | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY` | Right truncation |
| `MV03-justified-right-pad` | JUSTIFIED RIGHT padded on left | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY` | Space padding on left due to JUSTIFIED RIGHT |
| `MV04-justified-right-trunc` | JUSTIFIED RIGHT low-order kept | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY` | High-order end truncated, low-order kept |
| `MV05-group-copy-bytes` | Group to group byte copy without conversion | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ELEMENTARY` | Padded with spaces to target length |
| `MV06-same-zoned-shape-memcpy` | Same zoned shape copies bytes directly | `RT-CBL-MOVE-SAME-ZONED-SHAPE` | Non-digit byte travels as-is; sign rewrite never runs (register C11) |
| `MV07-numeric-to-alnum-unpunch` | Signed zoned to alphanumeric de-punches sign | `RT-CBL-MOVE-NUMERIC-TO-ALPHANUMERIC` | Negative overpunch K turned into unsigned digit 2 |
| `MV08-numeric-to-alnum-positive-unpunch` | Positive overpunch to alphanumeric | `RT-CBL-MOVE-NUMERIC-TO-ALPHANUMERIC` | Positive overpunch B turned into unsigned digit 2 |
| `MV09-numeric-separate-sign-dropped` | Separate sign dropped when moving to alphanumeric | `RT-CBL-MOVE-NUMERIC-TO-ALPHANUMERIC` | Leading separate sign dropped |
| `MV10-alnum-to-numeric-display` | Alphanumeric to zoned display with leading spaces skipped | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALPHANUMERIC-TO-NUMERIC` | Leading spaces skipped, digits zero padded |
| `MV11-alnum-to-numeric-invalid-char` | Alphanumeric to numeric with stray char becomes 0 | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALPHANUMERIC-TO-NUMERIC` | Stray non-digit before field full leaves destination ZERO |
| `MV12-deedit-currency-comma` | De-editing numeric edited with currency and comma | `RT-CBL-MOVE-DEEDIT` | Currency symbol and separators stripped, digits extracted |
| `MV13-deedit-negative-cr` | De-editing negative edited with CR | `RT-CBL-MOVE-DEEDIT` | CR sets negative sign, overpunched into last digit |
| `MV14-all-literal-to-alnum` | MOVE ALL literal to alphanumeric repeats pattern | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALL-LITERAL` | Pattern repeated from left edge |
| `MV15-all-literal-to-numeric` | MOVE ALL literal to numeric ends at right edge | `RT-CBL-MOVE-ALL-LITERAL` | GnuCOBOL/IBM aligns ALL pattern at right edge for numeric target |
